subject: Game Theory
title: Credible Commitments
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Credible Commitments.

hook.text: Cortés burned his ships after landing in Mexico. His soldiers had no retreat option. They fought harder.

buildup.text: In business, a credible commitment is an irreversible action that changes the game for everyone.

discovery.text: Building a factory commits a firm to a market. Competitors know it won't easily leave, so they adjust.

twist.text: Empty threats are ignored. Only commitments that are costly to reverse change rivals' behavior.

climax.text: Intel's massive chip fab investments commit it to Moore's Law. Competitors assume Intel will keep pushing.

punchline.text: Burning ships is a strategic choice.

quiz.question: What makes a commitment credible?
options: Writing it in a press release
